yds_subgrade_policy: Preserve text such as 5.4 as raw evidence. Encode its class bucket as 16; do not treat 5.10 as decimal 5.1 or invent within-class numerical spacing.
conditions_policy: Exclude snow/ice-dependent itineraries. Kiener removed. Dry-summer geometry still requires route review; ordinary summer routes may have seasonal snow.

duplicates.policy: 100 distinct official routes and timestamp-independent geometry hashes required. Shared approach segments remain allowed and must share evaluation groups where appropriate.
duplicates.evaluation_policy: Use connected components of shared source/geometry/related itinerary links as split groups. Shared paths do not constitute independent training evidence.
duplicates.rating_policy: No exact itinerary aliases in selected roster; do not rate a route against itself.
duplicates.pca_policy: Inspect spatial-overlap sensitivity; no repeated source labels in the cohort.

itinerary_policy.unit: One selection defines one complete walking/climbing itinerary, including approach and descent.
itinerary_policy.default_start: Lowest summer start explicitly published for the matched route; never infer a GPX start or mix lower and upper source totals.
itinerary_policy.default_descent: Reverse ascent unless an explicit published dry descent is specified.
itinerary_policy.chicago_basin: Start/finish at Needleton. Include approach and return; exclude rail travel and elapsed time.
itinerary_policy.quandary_west_ridge: Descend West Ridge; exclude Cristo Couloir snow descent.
itinerary_policy.missouri_west_ridge: Rockdale 2WD start/finish, including road walk to Clohesy Lake.
itinerary_policy.tour_de_abyss: Blue Sky Summit parking start/finish; Bierstadt then Blue Sky; include all walking return segments.
itinerary_policy.traverses: Honor requested direction. Include approach and standard dry descent; summit connectors alone are incomplete tracks.
itinerary_policy.access_status: Store independently of route difficulty. Do not infer legal summit permission from a source route label.
itinerary_policy.summit_order_definition: Ordered summit visits across the complete itinerary, including planned summit crossings on descent. Intended summit targets remain in required_summit.

metadata_identity_check.status: official route identities plus supplemental reports verified

source_access.smoke_test_policy: After source permission/access are available, verify robots, raw metadata, actual GPX links and GPX XML for an ordinary, technical and combined itinerary before bulk ingestion.
source_access.user_report_details: User authorized ordinary browser downloads and explicitly approved displayed GPX agreement on 2026-09-30; separate source-owner modeling/publication permission reference remains absent.

browser_download_review.account_required: official route downloads work signed out; GPX Library uses existing Chrome session
browser_download_review.acquisition_note: Original source GPX kept immutable; ascent tracks and candidate tracks are not automatically certified as complete dry itineraries.

data_hygiene.original_names: Immutable requested_name; corrected labels belong in canonical_name.
data_hygiene.nulls: Empty CSV cells mean unavailable, not zero. Booleans use true/false; IDs and URLs are text.
data_hygiene.provenance: Keep source URL/type/date, explicit overrides, response hashes and manifest/model versions.
data_hygiene.repository: Private GPX/cache/cookies excluded by .gitignore. No source bulk collection in Phase 1.
data_hygiene.canonical_files: Edit route_manifest.csv, project_config.json, block1_scraper.py and project_roadmap.md; regenerate notebook/bundle with scripts/sync_deliverables.py.
data_hygiene.change_control: Preserve selection IDs, increment manifest version for roster/scope changes, and update the reviewed SHA256. Validator fails on unreviewed edits.
data_hygiene.raw_grade_overrides: Keep observed yds_raw unchanged and record effective override plus its provenance separately.

feature_contract.yds_raw: string, includes qualifiers/subgrades; source or independently reviewed evidence
feature_contract.source_distance_mi: Published value tied to its named start and itinerary variant; not blindly the first number on the page.
feature_contract.source_gain_ft: Published cumulative uphill gain tied to start and itinerary variant.
feature_contract.gpx_distance_mi: Horizontal length of complete verified itinerary / 1609.344.
feature_contract.gpx_gain_ft: Positive cleaned elevation changes in meters * 3.28084.
feature_contract.crux_density_extreme: Horizontal-distance-weighted percent of validated profile with absolute percent grade >35; complete-itinerary value withheld until scope/QA passes.
feature_contract.crux_density_medium: Horizontal-distance-weighted percent with 20 <= absolute percent grade <=35; mutually exclusive with extreme.

cohort_selection.popularity_target: Retain current 100-selection roster. Use route-specific trip-report activity as the popularity indicator when considering additional/replacement routes.
cohort_selection.selection_evidence_required: Record dated route-specific trip-report references/counts for candidate additions. Do not infer route popularity from peak-level total reports. Current roster is retained; no global measured top-100 claim.
cohort_selection.shared_source_policy: Exact source aliases replaced under latest user instruction; overlapping approaches allowed.

dictionary.distance_mi: Horizontal length of complete verified itinerary in miles.
dictionary.gain_ft: Sum positive smoothed elevation changes of complete verified itinerary, feet.
dictionary.crux_density_medium: Percent valid horizontal distance at 20–35% absolute grade, inclusive.
dictionary.crux_density_extreme: Percent valid horizontal distance above 35% absolute grade.
dictionary.crux_medium_mi: Total horizontal miles in medium band.
dictionary.steep_above20_mi: Total horizontal miles at or above 20%, including extreme.
dictionary.longest_medium_mi: Longest uninterrupted horizontal run in medium band.
dictionary.longest_above20_mi: Longest uninterrupted horizontal run at or above 20%.
dictionary.yds_encoded: Official/effective class 1/2/3/4/5 encoded as 1/2/4/8/16; retain raw qualifier/subgrade.
dictionary.exposure_encoded: Observed source label encoded Low=0, Moderate=1, Considerable=2, High=3, Extreme=4.
dictionary.source_track_*: Provisional diagnostics on recorded geometry only; do not substitute for complete itinerary features.
dictionary.raw_track_*: Unsmoothed adjacent-point diagnostics after invalid edges/gaps are removed; recorded-track scope.
dictionary.profile_qa_pass: Sampling/gap, sensitivity, provenance and known-scope discrepancy checks pass. Does not verify complete dry itinerary.
dictionary.feature_eligible: Ingestion training_eligible AND profile QA passes.
dictionary.evaluation_group: Connected prior itinerary/shared-approach and approximate spatial-overlap groups; never predictor.
dictionary.profile_density_medium_range_pp: Range across 9 interval/window combinations, percentage points.
dictionary.profile_valid_distance_fraction: Accepted edge horizontal distance / all recorded within-sequence distance; no inter-sequence bridges.
dictionary.profile_density_extreme_range_pp: Same sensitivity range for extreme density, in percentage points.
dictionary.observed_segment_crux_density_medium: Percent of accepted recorded horizontal segment length at 20–35% smoothed absolute grade. Available independently of route-wide coverage acceptance.
dictionary.observed_segment_crux_density_extreme: Percent of accepted recorded horizontal segment length above 35% smoothed absolute grade. Not imputed or a complete-route claim.
dictionary.recorded_chord_crux_density_*_lower_pct: Accepted-band mileage divided by total recorded chord distance, percent; unknown excluded chords assumed outside this band.
dictionary.recorded_chord_crux_density_*_upper_pct: Lower bound plus excluded chord fraction in percent; unknown excluded chords assumed entirely in this band. Each band upper is separate, not a simultaneous allocation. Bounds do not account for unrecorded approaches/descent or chord-to-terrain error.

phase3.modeling_policy: Use density or steep mileage according to the model comparison; avoid blindly including all correlated mileage/density/longest-run columns in PCA. Raw diagnostics and smoothed versions are not duplicate model inputs. No final complete-cohort PCA before coverage and profile QA are reviewed.

execution_plan: Validate frozen feature/source/config provenance and record final website cluster/hover/neighbor requirements.
Define explicit eleven-feature synthetic teacher and original-nine, technical and endurance weight sensitivity scenarios.
Fit L2 linear Bradley–Terry and genuine shared eight-unit NumPy RankNet with dropout, Adam and validation early stopping.

phase5.ranknet_implementation: NumPy shared tanh MLP with pairwise sigmoid cross-entropy, Adam, dropout/L2, validation early stopping and finite-difference gradient tests; no new framework installation.
phase5.pair_semantics: P(A harder than B)=sigmoid(score_A-score_B); soft labels generated from explicit teacher only.

website_requirements.cluster_policy: Feature-space similarity groups are exploratory, not difficulty grades or confirmed natural categories. No cluster labels are inferred solely from visible UMAP/t-SNE islands.

execution_plan: Freeze roster/features and create an append-only SQLite assignment/event store with transactional Elo.
Expose fail-closed authenticated WSGI comparison endpoints; pseudonymize subjects, bind responses to server assignments and enforce idempotency/rate limits.
Reserve a frozen random evaluation pair pool, exclude it from rating training and active sampling, randomize display side and record selection probabilities.
Implement reproducible Elo replay and regularized sum-zero batch Bradley–Terry; exclude ties/skips/non-dry/non-experienced/evaluation events from binary fits.
Select training pairs through random coverage plus component bridges, vote coverage, provisional-model disagreement and diversity; keep repeat-pair history.
Validate vote ownership, retries, tampering, transactional rollback, evaluation isolation, rating direction, connectivity and voter-bootstrap behavior.
Deliver API/entity contract, empty honest community snapshot, frozen-pool evidence, full phase map and deployment next steps.
phase6.tie_policy: Elo uses y=.5 for qualified ties; batch binary BT excludes ties. Skips do not update either rating.
phase6.auth_policy: Inject server-validated session authentication into WSGI; default rejects writes. HMAC pseudonymization key must remain private. Client voter IDs and route identities are never trusted.
phase6.evaluation_policy: Random fixed pair holdout is never used for Elo/BT training or active acquisition; log evaluation responses separately. This measures outcomes on known routes, not generalization to unseen routes.
